mentions.name: HP ZBook Performance
mentions.description: This project uses a couple of scheduled AI prompts (Codex) to research, test, and apply Windows OS performance tuning settings, then publishes the resulting performance gains and system tweaks on an updates page and a GitHub repository for the author's HP ZBook.
mentions.problem: Frustration that the Windows GUI still struggles on hardware far more powerful than machines from 30 years ago, despite the UI being basically solved in the 90s.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am actually using AI to learn about Windows OS performance. I have a couple of prompts scheduled to research, test, and implement performance gains in the OS, then post them here [0] and here [1].
